notes.title: 10th Anniversary Special Thousand-Year Blood War Zenith Summons: Manifestation
notes.content:
[b]Available: 7/31 16:00 - 8/15 15:59 JST[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/0e348f8f97925d8d9e0584b66e208d5b9e45711a.png[/img]

Three characters from the BLEACH TV Animation Series: Thousand-Year Blood War have been added!

The draw rate for ★5 characters in this Summons is 6%. The x10 Summons guarantees one ★5 character every five Steps, except for Steps 25 and 50.

Furthermore, you'll receive the Choose a New ★5 Character Summons Ticket (Manifestation) at Step 25.

The Choose a New ★5 Character Summons Ticket (Manifestation) allows you to choose which one of the below characters you will receive.

Characters
- Jushiro (Thousand-Year Blood War 2025 version)
- Renji (Thousand-Year Blood War 2025 version)
- Uryu (Thousand-Year Blood War 2025 version)

At Step 50, you'll receive the 10th Anniversary Choose a ★5 Character Summons Ticket (Manifestation).

The 10th Anniversary Choose a ★5 Character Summons Ticket (Manifestation) allows you to choose one of the Thousand-Year Blood War characters that appeared up to July 31, 2024, including the newly introduced characters.

Check out the characters' abilities on the official Brave Souls YouTube channel!
[previewyoutube=EOsKBmRsHwk;full][/previewyoutube]

See below for details.

[h2]Character Details: Jushiro[/h2]
[b]・Characteristics[/b]
- Attack type: Ranged strong attack
- Strong attack 2: superior strong attack
- Special Move: Insta-kill chance
- All attacks: Paralysis+
- EX Move: Super homing vortex
- Arrancar Killer+
- EX Skill: Berserker +30%
- Skill: Frenzy +3
- Skill: Damage to Paralyzed enemies +80%
- Skill: (Team/Party) Strong Attack Recharge 10%
- Skill: All Status Ailments Resistance 200%

[b]・Character Details[/b]
Jushiro can inflict Paralysis+ with all of his attacks, allowing him to stop his enemies in their tracks and take the advantage in battle. As a "+" type status ailment, Paralysis+ can be stacked with other status ailments, maximizing their impact.

He has the extremely powerful "Frenzy +3" and "Berserker +80%," enabling him to deal massive damage with his strong attacks. Additionally, Jushiro possesses the new EX Skill "EX Berserker +30%," which further boosts his strong attack damage.

His second strong attack is a superior strong attack that deals greater damage than standard ones. He can also utilize the EX Move "Super homing vortex" to automatically track enemies and unleash wide-area attacks. With its high hit count, his second strong attack is exceptional at inflicting status ailments on enemies.

With "Bombardment +1" and powerful skills such as "Status Ailment Spiritual Pressure Boost +100%," "Damage to Paralyzed Enemies +80%," and "Weaken Defense" Jushiro can deal devastating damage with his Special Move.

His Soul Trait "Strong attack recharge time -14%" and EX Skill "EX Berserker +30%" can be shared with other characters by placing him in their first link slot, making him an excellent choice for a character link.

Available for the first time as a skill, Jushiro has "(Team/Party) Strong Attack Recharge 10%." He boasts the ability to nullify even "+" type status ailments with "All Status Ailment Resistances 200%" and possesses other useful skills such as "Long Stride" and the Innate Skill "Sharpshooter," allowing him to navigate various quests with ease.

Equipped with Arrancar Killer+ and the ability to deal significant damage with his strong attacks and Special Move, Jushiro shines in high-difficulty quests like Guild Quests with Arrancar Killer and increased ranged damage rules.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/52c7e890079eafede930f3f14a61f911e5d2ef81.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=05sWc4jWzLM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Character Details: Renji[/h2]
[b]・Characteristics[/b]
- Attack type: Ranged strong attack
- Strong attack 2: superior strong attack
- Strong attack 3: Two-stage charged attack
- Normal attack, strong attack 2, EX Move: Lacerate+
- Strong attack 1, strong attack 3, Special Move: Lacerate/Burn
- EX Move: Massive Spiritual Pressure Boost
- Quincy Killer+
- EX Skill: Damage to Lacerated Enemies +40%
- Skill: Frenzy +3
- Skill: (Soul Reaper Resonance) Strong Attack Damage +10%
- Skill: Poise Break (Except Brave Battles)
- Skill: Weaken Resistance 200%

[b]・Character Details[/b]
Renji can inflict Lacerate and Burn with his first and third strong attacks, as well as his Special Move. If successful, both status ailments will deal continuous damage to those inflicted as well as prevent them from using their strong attacks. As a "+" type status ailment, the Lacerate+ on his normal attack, second strong attack, and EX Move can also be stacked with other status ailments, maximizing their impact.

By inflicting Lacerate on enemies, Renji activates "Status Ailment Spiritual Pressure Boost +80%". When this is combined with the powerful "Damage to Lacerated Enemies +80%," and the new EX Skill "EX Damage to Lacerated Enemies +40%," his damage output increases significantly.

Renji's EX Move "Massive Spiritual Pressure Boost" allows him to boost his Spiritual Pressure by 100% for 10 seconds. Unleashing this and then making use of his second strong attack, a superior strong attack, the two-stage charged attack on his third strong attack, and his Special Move can result in explosive damage.

With powerful skills like "Frenzy +3" and "Berserker +60%," Renji excels at dealing massive damage through his strong attacks. His Special Move also really packs a punch thanks to "Bombardment +1" and "Weaken Defense."

Renji's Soul Trait "Strong attack recharge time -14%" and the ability to share his EX Skill "EX Damage to Lacerated Enemies +40%" through the first character link slot make him an excellent link for characters who can inflict Lacerate.

With Quincy Killer+, "Weakness Resistance 200%" allowing him to nullify even the Weakness+ status ailment, and "Poise Break (Except Brave Battles)" to go head-to-head against enemies with Poise, Renji shines in high-difficulty content with Quincy Killer and increased ranged damage rules, such as Guild Quests and the Limit Breaker Quest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/3231de16bfa6377e655ec258b5f1926c74e0ac1b.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=JVkIdZN2SV4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Character Details: Uryu[/h2]
[b]・Characteristics[/b]
- Attack type: Ranged normal attack
- Killer: Stern Ritter Killer/Soul Reaper Killer
- Soul Trait: Damage taken -21%
- EX Skill: Bruiser +30%
- Skill: Flurry +3
- New Skill: (Brave Battles Only) Opening Stat Boost
- New Skill: (Brave Battles Only) Block Boosts and Debuffs
- Skill: (Brave Battles Only) Persistence
- Skill: (Brave Battles Only) Persistence Breaker

[b]・Character Details[/b]
Uryu is exceptionally well-suited to Brave Battles, as he has defensive skills such as "Brave Battle Temporary Invincibility" and "(Brave Battles Only) Persistence" that grant him the staying power to withstand even the fiercest of attacks. Additionally, he also has "(Brave Battles Only) Persistence Breaker," "Ignore Brave Battle Invincibility," and "(Brave Battles Only) Prevent Last-Ditch Survival" to negate the defensive capabilities of his opponents.

Uryu has the newly introduced, "(Brave Battles Only) Opening Stat Boost", which enhances his Attack, Defense, and Focus stats for a limited time at the start of the battle. Combining this with the powerful, "(Brave Battles Only) Block Boosts and Debuffs" makes Uryu capable of stopping his enemies from both boosting themselves and debuffing him throughout the fight.

His Soul Trait of "Damage taken -21%" makes him a valuable option for first-slot character links as besides his Soul Trait he can also share his EX Skill "EX Bruiser +30%." This makes him highly effective as a character link for normal attack-focused characters.

In addition to his ability "Flurry +3," Uryu boasts "Bruiser +40%" and the EX Skill "EX Bruiser +30%" and has two killer effects: Stern Ritter Killer and Soul Reaper Killer. This means that he can go head-to-head with many characters in terms of raw firepower, making him a standout option for dealing heavy damage in a variety of different scenarios.

[previewyoutube=MbcE7FErHBE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.content:
[b]Available: 7/22 16:00 - 7/31 15:59 JST[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/a7def7638bfa632d2d36ebc189c6018f1c4f1317.png[/img]

To celebrate the 10th anniversary, we're adding the 10th Anniversary Zenith Summons!

The draw rate for ★5 characters in this Summons is 6%. The x10 Summons guarantees one ★5 character every five Steps, except for Steps 25 and 50.

Furthermore, you'll receive the Choose a New ★5 Character Summons Ticket (10th Anniv.) at Step 25.

The Choose a New ★5 Character Summons Ticket (10th Anniv.) allows you to choose which one of the below characters you will receive.

Characters
- Ichigo (10th Anniversary version)
- Rukia (10th Anniversary version)

Furthermore, Step 50 comes with a free 10th Anniversary Special Choose a ★5 Summons Ticket (10th Anniv.) and Rainbow Special Move Source!

The 10th Anniversary Special Choose a ★5 Summons Ticket (10th Anniv.) allows you to choose one of the Thousand-Year Blood War characters that appeared up to May 31, 2024, including the newly introduced characters.

The Ichigo (10th Anniversary version) and Rukia (10th Anniversary version) introduced in this Summons will be bonus characters in Events, Attribute Tree Grounds, and Epic Raids released until the end of December.

Enjoy the 10th Anniversary celebrations with Ichigo (10th Anniversary version) and Rukia (10th Anniversary version)!

Check out the characters' abilities on the official Brave Souls YouTube channel!
[previewyoutube=WV0gx-S01lA;full][/previewyoutube]

See below for details.

[h2]Character Details: Ichigo[/h2]
[b]・Characteristics[/b]
- Attack type: Ranged strong attack
- Strong attacks 2 and 3: superior strong attacks
- Special Move: Debuff
- All attacks: Paralysis+
- EX Move: Continuous Sweeping Attacks
- Human Killer+
- New EX Skill: EX Berserker +30%
- Skill: Berserker (+100%)
- Skill: Frenzy +3
- Skill: Bombardment +2
- Skill: Damage inflicted at full STA +50%
- Skill: All Status Ailments Resistance 200%

[b]・Character Details[/b]
Ichigo can inflict Paralysis+ with all of his attacks, allowing him to stop his enemies in their tracks and take the advantage in battle. As a "+" type status ailment, Paralysis+ can be stacked with other status ailments, maximizing their impact.

He boasts exceptionally powerful skills, including "Frenzy +3" and "Berserker +100%," making him capable of dealing massive damage with his strong attacks. On top of that, the new skill "EX Berserker +30%" further boosts his strong attack damage, enabling him to overwhelm enemies with devastating force.

Both his second and third strong attacks are superior strong attacks that deal greater damage compared to normal strong attacks. Additionally, his EX Move "Continuous Sweeping Attack" unleashes a super-powerful continuous attack centered around himself, striking a wide area for several seconds and delivering damage to surrounding enemies. This EX Move is not only powerful but also has a 50-second cooldown, allowing Ichigo to rack up high damage with a shorter turn-around.

He is the first character to possess the skill "Bombardment +2." Furthermore, Ichigo is equipped with other powerful skills, including "Full Stamina Damage Boost +50%," "Status Ailment Spiritual Pressure Boost +100%," and "Weaken Defense." These skills make his Special Move capable of dealing extraordinary amounts of damage.

Ichigo also has the Soul Trait "Strong attack recharge time -14%" and can share the EX Skill "EX Berserker +30%" when placed in the first link slot of a base character. This makes him a powerful choice as a character link for other team members.

Since Ichigo has "All Status Ailment Resistances +200%," he can nullify even "+" type status ailments. Combined with other useful skills such as "Sharpshooter" and "Long Stride," he performs well across a variety of quests.

With Human Killer+ and the skill "Poise Break (Except Brave Battles)," Ichigo can nullify enemy Poise and deal massive damage through his strong attacks and Special Move. This makes him invaluable in high-difficulty contents such as Guild Quests and Limit Breaker Quests with Human Killer and Increased Ranged Damage rules.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/cd11772a127266eecca198d9507684250625de8b.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=IxuvPN3Y8HU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Character Details: Rukia[/h2]
[b]・Characteristics[/b]
- Attack type: Melee strong attack
- Strong attack 2: superior strong attack
- Special Move: Automatic revival
- All attacks: Freeze+
- EX Move: Wide-Range Freezing Static Vortex
- Stern Ritter Killer+
- New EX Skill: EX Status Ailment Spiritual Pressure Boost +35%
- Skill: Status Ailment Spiritual Pressure Boost +100%
- Skill: Berserker (+100%)
- Skill: Frenzy +3
- Skill: Damage to Frozen Enemies +80%
- Skill: All Status Ailments Resistance 200%

[b]・Character Details[/b]
All of Rukia's attacks can inflict Freeze+ and her multi-hit second strong attack has the powerful "Increased Status Ailment Chance Against Quincies," making her adept at stopping her enemies dead in their tracks. As a "+" type status ailment, Freeze+ can be stacked with other status ailments, maximizing their impact.

Once she has inflicted Freeze+ on her enemies, "Status Ailment Spiritual Pressure Boost +100%" activates, further boosting her damage output. She has the new EX Skill "EX Status Ailment Spiritual Pressure Boost," which when combined with "Damage to Frozen Enemies + 80%" makes for a devastating damage boost.

Her EX Move "Wide-Range Freezing Static Vortex" allows her to activate a static vortex around herself that can inflict Freeze on surrounding enemies. Get the timing right, and Rukia can Freeze large groups of enemies, then follow up with strong attacks or Special Moves to deal massive damage.

Rukia also has the extremely powerful "Frenzy +3" and "Berserker +100%" to ensure that her strong attacks really pack a punch. But it's not just her strong attacks that send her enemies reeling. "Bombardment +1" and "Weaken Defense" mean that Rukia can deal crippling damage as well as reduce enemies' Defense with her Special Move.

Her Soul Trait "Strong attack recharge time -14%" and EX Skill "EX Status Ailment Spiritual Pressure Boost" can be shared with another character by placing her in the character's first character link slot, making her excellent support for characters that inflict status ailments.

Since Rukia has "All Status Ailment Resistances +200%," she can nullify even "+" type status ailments. Combined with other useful skills such as "Marauder" and "Long Stride," she performs well across a variety of quests.

Rukia has Stern Ritter Killer+ and can deal devastating damage with both her strong attacks and Special Move. This makes her immensely valuable in quests with Human Killer and Increased Melee Damage rules.

notes.content:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/f758b09ee38507e3574f73363860e6bce7136790.png[/img]

We're introducing two new characters with the addition of the Renewed Version Step-Up Summons.

The Renewed Version Step-Up Summons comes in both single-pull and x10 types, and the first pull from both Summons is free! From Step 2 each Step comes with extra bonus items, and Step 6 of the x10 Summons guarantees you one of the twelve featured ★5 characters.

There are seven Steps in total. The Steps do not reset, but you can use Step 7 as many times as you like.

[previewyoutube=Bmc3-4aT9iE;full][/previewyoutube]

See below for details.

[h2]Character Details: Aizen[/h2]
[b]・Characteristics[/b]
- Attack type: Ranged strong attack
- Strong attack 2: Homing vortex
- All attacks: Dominate and Drain
- EX Move: Forward-Facing Wide-Range Static Vortex
- Captain Killer+
- Soul Traits: Strong Attack Recharge Time -12% and Strong attack damage +20%
- Skill: Damage to Dominated Enemies +100%
- Skill: Bombardment +1

[b]・Character Details[/b]
All of Aizen's attacks can inflict Dominate and Drain, allowing him to force enemies into fighting among themselves without taking damage himself, all while replenishing his own Stamina and preventing them from inflicting status ailments of their own.

His EX Move, "Forward-Facing Wide-Range Static Vortex," places a static vortex capable of wide-range attacks in front of him. Timing this with the homing vortex unleashed by his second strong attack allows him to inflict enemies already under fire from the static vortex with both Dominate and Drain, making him a formidable force during quests.

With the extremely powerful "Damage to Dominated Enemies 100%" and "Status Ailment Spiritual Pressure Boost 80%," he can deal even more damage to enemies he has inflicted with Dominate.

Thanks to the combination of "Bombardment +1," "Devastation 50%," and "Weaken Defense," Aizen's Special Move can deal huge damage to his enemies.

Aizen also has two Soul Traits: "Strong attack recharge time -12%" and "Strong attack damage +20%," making him very useful as a character link.

Finally, Aizen has Captain Killer+ and other powerful skills that give him an edge in Guild Quests or high-difficulty quests with Captain Killer or Increased Ranged Damage rules.

- EX Move: Wide-Range Vortex on Self
- Stern Ritter Killer+
- Soul Traits: Strong Attack Recharge Time -12% and Strong attack damage +20%
- Skill: Frenzy +3
- Skill: Damage to Paralyzed Enemies +50%
- Skill: Bombardment +1

[b]・Character Details[/b]
All of Byakuya's attacks can inflict Paralysis+, allowing him to restrain enemies. As a "+" type status ailment, Paralysis+ can be stacked with other status ailments, maximizing the impact of status effects.

With the extremely powerful "Frenzy +3" and "(Full Stamina Only) Increased Strong Attack Damage 40%," Byakuya can deal immense damage with his strong attacks.

Thanks to "Increased Status Ailment Chance Against Quincies," he can more easily inflict Paralysis+ on Quincy enemies. He can then take advantage of "Damage to Paralyzed Enemies +50%" and "Status Ailment Spiritual Pressure Boost +80%" to deal huge amounts of damage.

With his EX Move, "Wide-Range Vortex on Self," he can prevent enemies from closing in, or move towards them to deal damage and inflict Paralysis+.

Byakuya has both "Bombardment +1" and "Weaken Defense," making his Special Move an exceptionally powerful trump card.

Like Aizen, he also has two Soul Traits: "Strong attack recharge time -12%" and "Strong attack damage +20%," making him very useful as a character link.

Finally, Byakuya has Stern Ritter Killer+ and other powerful skills that give him an edge in Guild Quests or high-difficulty quests with Stern Ritter Killer or Increased Ranged Damage rules.

By unleashing powerful attacks like his charged two-stage third strong attack or his Special Move during this boost, he can deal astonishing damage.

In addition to his inherent high power, skills such as "Marauder," "Poise Break (Except Brave Battles)," and "Weaken Defense" enable Kenpachi to display immense power in various quests, mowing down enemies left and right.

notes.content:

To celebrate the 8th anniversary, we'll be adding the 8th Anniversary Step-Up Summons.

The 8th Anniversary x10 Step-Up Summons and the 8th Anniversary Step-Up Summons will both be available, and both are free to use the first time!

From Step 2 onward, each Step comes with extra bonus items, and Step 6 of the x10 Summons guarantees you one of the twelve featured ★5 characters.

There are seven Steps in total. The Steps do not reset, but you can use Step 7 as many times as you like.

This Summons features special 8th Anniversary versions of Ichigo and White!

The might of the inseparable, Ichigo Kurosaki.

Ichigo is a ranged strong attack character with the Hollow Killer and No Affiliation Killer skills.

All of his attacks can inflict both Weaken and Drain, and he has Frenzy +3, meaning his strong attacks can really pack a punch. In addition, his new skill "Poise Break (Except Brave Battles)" lets him tear through enemies on the battlefield.

His second strong attack gathers enemies together to hammer them with an attack, and then automatically ploughs through them with a homing vortex! Through Special Souls his Soul Trait can be powered up to Strong Attack Recharge Time -14%, letting him unleash strong attacks with increased frequency.

Thanks to powerful abilities and Innate Skills such Shared Complete Status Immunity, Sharpshooter, Hit Hidden Enemy Chance: 100%, and Read All Affiliation Dodges, Ichigo will come in useful in a variety of quests.

The source of black and white, White!

White is a melee strong attack character with the Soul Reaper Killer and No Affiliation Killer skills.

All of his attacks can inflict both Drain and Lacerate, and he has both Frenzy +2 and Bombardment +1, making him a destructive presence on the battlefield.

He also has the new skill "(Team/Party) Mind Attribute Character Special Move Damage +30%," which means even characters fighting with him get a damage boost when using Special Moves. This, combined with his ability to learn the Weaken Defense skill, makes him a force to be reckoned with when it comes to Special Moves!

Furthermore, he can make use of Increased Status Ailment Chance Against Heart Attribute Enemies and his multi-hit strong attack to inflict status ailments on enemies, and then through Status Ailment Spiritual Pressure Boost +80%, Damage to Drained Enemies +40%, and Damage to Lacerated Enemies +60%, deal explosive damage to anyone unlucky enough to find themselves up against him.

While he is destroying enemies with status ailments, he himself is immune to them thanks to Complete Status Immunity 100%, making him useful in a variety of different quests.

He is the first character to have the skill Sprinter +3 and be able to acquire (Team/Party) Increased Mind Attribute Character Movement Speed +30%, meaning he can dart around the battlefield destroying his enemies.

Ichigo Kurosaki, A shot to dispel the shadows!
Ichigo is a ranged strong attack character with the Soul Reaper Killer and Arrancar Killer abilities. All of his attacks have a chance to inflict Paralysis and Weaken, and he comes with the new Innate Skill Immobilizer + Enervator, which gives him a chance to inflict Paralysis and Weaken on nearby enemies at regular intervals. His second strong attack is a homing vortex that homes in on the nearest enemy while sucking in any other nearby enemies.He also has the new skill Shared Complete Status Immunity, which reduces the duration of inflicted status ailments to both Ichigo and his allies!

He can also learn the Sharpshooter and Hit Hidden Enemies skills! This means that enemies cannot guard against any of his attacks, and they lose their ability to negate his ranged attacks!

When this Gauge Effect is activated the remaining time until you can use a strong attack again is reduced, making it easier to pummel your enemies with strong attacks!

Uryu can learn Frenzy +2 and Havoc (+20%) as well as the new skills Guard Break + Hit Hidden Enemies, Increased Status Ailment Chance Against Power Attribute Enemies, and (Team/Party) Increased Speed Attribute Character Strong Attack Damage. notes.title: Version 14.0.1 update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Bleach: Brave Souls! This notice contains information about the version 14.0.1 update.

[h2]Version 14.0.1 Update[/h2]

[h3]Soul Ticket Boost Settings[/h3]
The Use 5 Soul Tickets button on the Prepare for Quest screen of Sub Stories, Chronicle Quests, and events will be adjusted so that players can set the amount of tickets to be used. Players may choose to use between 1 and 10 tickets.

If a Brave Souls Bonanza Pass is active when 5 Soul Tickets are used, an extra ticket's worth of rewards will be received. Please be aware that some quests have a limit to the amount of times they can be cleared and the amount of Soul Tickets to be used cannot be set higher than this limit.

Please make use of this feature to use more Soul Tickets, and get more rewards, than before.

[h3]Character Filters Added[/h3]
Link Slots, Transcendence, and Character Power-Up Status have been added to the filter screen. These additions will allow players to apply more detailed filters.

We have also adjusted the display on the filter screen. This should make it easier to search for characters that are still in the process of being powered-up, as well as those without badges.

Some filters are still under development and cannot be used at the moment.

[h3]Room Rules and Kick Feature Added[/h3]

Room Rules can now be set for Co-Op Quests and Epic Raids.

Players will be able to set a room message, as well as preferences/limits for Player Rank, Brave Battle League, Level, Attribute, Transcendence level, Link Slot level, Skills, and Status Ailment Duration Reduction (80% or more). However, players cannot set limits on Player Rank, Brave Battle League, Transcendence level, or Link Slot level that are higher than their own.

If Room Rules have been set, the room owner can tap and hold on a character other than their own to see that player's details. From that screen they can also kick that player out of the room.

- When a skill has been set in the room rules, only characters with that exact skill currently activated will be able to enter the room.

Example: If the room rules have been set to allow characters with Reduced Strong Attack Cooldown to enter, those with only (Full Stamina Only) Reduced Strong Attack Cooldown will not be able to enter the room.

- Characters with skills activated through Character Links will be able to enter the room.

Example: If the room rules have been set to allow characters with Decreased Damage Taken and a character has activated that skill through a Character Link, they will be able to enter the room.

[h3]Account Deletion[/h3]

Players will now be able to request that their account be deleted from the Title screen menu. The account, and all associated data, will be permanently deleted two weeks after the request. Once deleted, there is no way to recover the deleted data.

[h3]Test Play Time Limit Adjustment[/h3]

The time limit on test playing a character will be changed from 30 seconds to 60 seconds. This additional time will allow players to make use of buffs, barriers, and other strong attacks with long cooldown times more than once.

[h3]Issues Fixed[/h3]

- When 5 Soul Tickets were used on Story Events, the Points shown on the Results screen were sometimes not shown as the boosted amount. This issue has now been fixed. This issue was purely cosmetic and the correct amount of Points was being received.

- Reduced the frequency of data download errors.

- Fixed an in-game issue wherein a member leaving a Co-Op Quest would result in the displayed order of characters on the Create Party and Player Info screens not matching.

We apologize for any inconvenience and hope you continue to enjoy the game.

notes.title: 6th Anniversary Step-Up Summons
notes.content:
[h3]This Summons features the special 6th Anniversary version of Aizen!

Sosuke Aizen, without fear![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/a5240a296a97a6906868cc934fa26d0bdc6841fa.png[/img]

Aizen is a ranged strong attack character with the Soul Reaper Killer and Captain Killer abilities. He comes with the new "Dodge Soul Reaper Damage 50%" Innate Skill, which means he has a 50% chance to ignore all damage when being attacked by Soul Reapers. 

He is also the first character with attacks that have a chance of inflicting multiple status ailments. All of his attacks have a chance to inflict both Weaken and Drain! Add to this Frenzy +2, 20% Havoc, and a five-second Debilitator and you have a character who truly has the potential to stand at the top.

That's not all, though! As if Aizen wasn't formidable enough already, he can also unlock "Hit Hidden Enemies" and is only the second character ever capable of unlocking the "Sharpshooter" skill, which nullifies both ranged guard and Ranged Attack Resistance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/822a8f33c46f86df85d68d20071f18db43e35a4f.png[/img]

[h3]Dodge Soul Reaper Damage 50%[/h3]
This skill gives the character a percentage chance to ignore all damage from Soul Reapers' attacks. However, please note that this skill does not stack with other abilities or Accessories that grant a percentage change to ignore damage or ranged damage. This skill has no effect if the attacking character has a "Read Dodges" skill that matches the defending character's Affiliation.

[h3]Multiple Status Ailment-Inflicting Attacks[/h3]
These attacks have a chance of inflicting two different status ailments. When an attack successfully inflicts a status ailment, only one status ailment graphical effect will be displayed, but the effects of both status ailments will be inflicted at the same time.

If the defending character is resistant to one of the status ailments, only the status ailment that the character is not resistant to will be inflicted. If a character possesses the "Debilitator" or "Disabler" skills, or an "Increased Damage to Status Ailment-Affected Enemies" skill, these skills will affect both status ailments. Skills such as "Damage to Weakened Enemies" that only apply to one of the status ailments will still have an effect.

notes.title: Version 12.0.0 Update
notes.content:
Version 12.0.0 Update

New "Bonus Abilities" Function
We have added a new method of making your favorite characters even stronger than before. 

Bonus Abilities are extra abilities that you can choose for a character. You can set a maximum of two Bonus Abilities to each character. The first Bonus Ability slot unlocks when you power up all a character's Character Link slots to level 15, and the second Bonus Ability Slot unlocks when you power up all Character Link slots to level 20.

Bonus Abilities
One Bonus Ability can be set in each Bonus Ability slot. However, the same Bonus Ability cannot be set twice to the same character. Also, some Bonus Abilities have a limit to their maximum effectiveness. If the combined effect of a Bonus Ability and the maximum effect of any Soul Traits, Innate Abilities, and Skills a character can attain by fully upgrading their Soul Tree exceeds the limit for a given ability, the relevant Bonus Ability cannot be applied to that character.

We have identified an issue whereby a pop-up about unlocking Bonus Ability slots will mistakenly be displayed again when checking the Bonus Ability slots after Resurrecting a character that already had Bonus Ability slots unlocked.

We plan to fix this issue in a future update. Please note that this is only an error with the pop-up. Bonus Ability slots are still carried over to Resurrected characters.

Available Bonus Abilities

Bonus Abilities with Maximum Effect Limits

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/e9bbd09ef9dfc27fadb7206ed1518c746e6c3201.png[/img]
- Bonus Ability values listed as "Same as skill" have the same effect as the standard skill of the same name.
- Maximum limits indicated by numerals rather than percentages indicate how many times a character can have that ability. This is the combined number of Bonus Abilities as well as Soul Traits, Innate Skills, and Skills a character can attain by fully upgrading their Soul Tree. A Bonus Ability cannot be applied to a character if the result would exceed this limit.

Bonus Abilities without Maximum Effect Limits

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/87ed0e71247bfdd7142e6682f407290486196e01.png[/img]

Bonus Ability values listed as "Same as skill" have the same effect as the standard skill of the same name.

Character Link Slot Levels
The maximum Character Link slot level will be increased from 10 to 20. Increasing a Character Link slot level to level 20 will increase the stats the base character inherits from the linked character to 30%. Coins and Link Slot Potions, Super Link Slot Potions, and Droplets of the same Attribute as the base character are required to increase a link slot's level beyond ten. Super Link Slot Potions can be acquired from Inheritance Trials. 

Character Level Indicator
With the addition of level 20 Character Link slots, the character level color will now change when the character has three level 20 Character Link slots rather than three level 10 Character Links slots.

As a result, some characters' level indicators will change when the update is implemented. We also plan to make some adjustments to the character level indicator in a future update to make it easier to tell at a glance how far a character has been powered up.

Inheritance Trials
Inheritance Trials are time-limited high-difficulty quests. Some enemies in Inheritance Trials have the new "Iron Skin" ability, which means they suffer a reduced amount of damage from attacks. However, this effect is nullified when the enemy is suffering from a status ailment. You can check which enemies have the Iron Skin ability in the Rules section for a quest.

Inheriting Stats
Character Link slots of levels 11 through 20 will impart the following stat percentages to the base character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/478d5fef33acad9ec8f9e8158fa76a13c461d953.png[/img]

- Event specifications, availability times, and in-game balance are subject to change without notice.


New Quest Type
Inheritance Trials are new high-difficulty quests where you can acquire the materials you need to power up your characters' Character Link slots to level 20. Inheritance Trials come in both single-player and Co-Op varieties, each with their own special rules.

Adjustments to Dupe Character Rewards
We will be making some adjustments to the rewards players receive when pulling a duplicate character from a Summons. The adjustments to the rewards will be implemented at a later date. 

Adjustments to Quest Preparation Screens
Player selections such as stage rules tabs, special rules tabs, ally selections, and so on will now be saved independently for different quest preparations screens. Also, an "EQUIP!!!" alert will now be displayed if one or more characters in your selected team is not fully equipped with Accessories and Character Links.

Adjustment to Resurrection Trials
Resurrection Rings will now be slightly easier to obtain in Resurrection Trials.

Adjustments to Some Soul Trait and Accessory Descriptions
In order to differentiate Soul Trait and Accessory effects that previously used the word "dodge" from the recently added Dodge ability that some enemies possess, we have altered some text so that Soul Traits and Accessories that give a percentage chance to ignore all damage from attack will now use the word "evasion." Please note that this is just a change in the wording. No change has been made to the effect of these Soul Traits or Accessories.

Issues Fixed
- Players not being matched with AI opponents in Brave Battle leagues Seat 8 to Seat 10.

We apologize for any inconvenience and hope you continue to enjoy the game.

notes.title: The Machine Society Summons: Magic and Steam
notes.content:
New characters from the steampunk world of the Machine Society are here!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/6d9305268cb3ee76d75e16a4d0f57bd11fbed5c1.png[/img]

[h1]Yoruichi Shihoin[/h1]
[previewyoutube=zGakcJEPJDQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Yoruichi is a melee strong attack character with the Hollow Killer ability. She comes with both the "Read Hollow Dodges" and "Poison Immunity" Innate Abilities built in at ★5. All of her attacks apart from her second strong attack have a chance to inflict Burn, which combines excellently her 20% Havoc, Frenzy, two-second Debilitator, and Guard Break skills. She is also a useful support character as her second strong attack is a Boost move that can be upgraded by unlocking her Enhancer skill.

[h1]Nemu Kurotsuchi[/h1]
[previewyoutube=3gf3jNvuPYI;full][/previewyoutube]
Nemu is a ranged strong attack character with the Hollow Killer ability, and she comes with the "Freeze Immunity" Innate Ability built in at ★5. All of her attacks have a chance to inflict Paralysis. Combined with her Frenzy, Havoc, and five-second Debilitator skills, plus a charged third strong attack, this gives her the potential to deal significant damage against opponents who are unable to fight back. She can also unlock "Increased Status Ailment Chance Against Speed Attribute Hollows," which greatly increases her chance of inflicting Paralysis to Speed Attribute Hollows. Finally, she can also unlock the "(Team/Party) Technique Attribute Soul Reaper Strong Attack Damage +20%" skill that increases the strong attack damage for any Technique Attribute Soul Reapers in the same Team or Party as Nemu by 20%. (Please note that the "(Team/Party) Technique Attribute Soul Reaper Strong Attack Damage +20%" skill does not stack if you have more than one character with the same skill in a team or party.) 

"Increased Status Ailment Chance Against Speed Attribute Hollows" and "(Team/Party) Technique Attribute Soul Reaper Strong Attack Damage +20%" will be the Nemu's Attainable Skills list at a later date.

[h1]Mashiro Kuna[/h1]
[previewyoutube=b9SzyjhGqcw;full][/previewyoutube]
Mashiro is a ranged strong attack character with the Arrancar Killer ability. All of her attacks have a chance to inflict Weaken, which combines excellently with her 20% Havoc, five-second Debilitator, and Reduced Strong Attack Cooldown -12% skills. She can also unlock Guard Break and the new Increased Mind Droplet Drop +17% skill, making her a very useful character for farming.

These new characters will be added to the Epic Raid Advantage character list of the Shrieker Awakened Epic Raid and as bonus characters for The Machine Society: The Key of Magic event.

The EXP and Coins in Kon's Bonanza will be doubled while The Machine Society Summons: Magic and Steam is available, so you will be able to easily power up any new characters you are lucky enough to pull.

Increased Mind Droplet Drop
This skill increases the number of Mind Droplets the character acquires during quests. This skill is triggered when the character is included in a team. The effect of this skill stacks if multiple characters with the same skill are included in a team in both single-player quests and Co-Op quests.

Please note that the effects of this skill do not pass on to the base character when a character with this skill is used as a link. The effects of this skill also do not trigger if a character with this skill is taken along on a quest as an ally.

notes.title: Version 11.2 Update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Bleach: Brave Souls! This notice contains information about the version 11.2 update.

Version 11.2 Update

Adjustments to Co-Op Character Selection
We have made some improvements to Co-Op quests screen to make the character selection process smoother. You can now set up to five "Decks" for each Attribute in Co-Op quests. If you enter a Co-Op Quest room with an Attribute limitation, you will automatically enter the room equipped from the relevant Deck. You can also now change Accessories and Character Links when changing characters.

Changes to Packs Screen
We have made some adjustments to the Packs screen and added the ability to view notices related to Packs from the same screen.

Strategy Topic Added
We have added a "Skills" topic to the Strategy menu. The Strategy menu can be found at the bottom of the News screen.

Changes to Loading Screens
We have made some adjustments to the loading screens that show character details.

We hope you continue to enjoy the game.

notes.title: Version 11.1 Update
notes.content:
Steam Version Key Config
We have added the ability to alter the key configuration for the Steam version.

New Accessories
We have added three new Accessories. See the "New Accessories coming with version 11.1" notice in-game for more details.

Adjustments to Using 5 Soul Tickets for Co-Op
For Co-Op Quest room owners, the setting for using 5 Soul Tickets will now carry over from your previous run for the same quest. 

Adjustments to the Treatment of Lost Connections During Co-Op
Soul Tickets will no longer be consumed if your connection is lost on a Co-Op Quest loading screen. Also, if the room owner's connection is lost while the quest is loading, you will now have the option to retire without losing any Soul Tickets as soon as the quest starts. However, if your connection is lost during a Co-Op Quest, any spent Soul Tickets will still be consumed.

We hope you continue to enjoy the game.
